findings_not_failures.finding: The one decoded budget bounds what the --audio decodes keep, not what one decode holds. cli_audio_within passes min(ImportLimits::max_frames, remainder / 4) mono frames as reel's frame limit and charges frames x channels x 4 only after decode_audio_file returns; reel's decode_all bounds kept frames per block, not samples, and admits up to MAX_AUDIO_CHANNELS = 8 channels (WAV, FLAC, AAC). An 8-channel FLAC of constant subframes (a few KiB, under every file-size check) therefore decodes 518 400 000 x 8 x 4 = 16 588 800 000 bytes (4x the 4 147 200 000-byte budget) before audio_too_large; after a first file charged at half the budget the peak is about 18.7 GB (4.5x). The lane disclosed the mechanism ('one decode can transiently hold up to channels x remainder bytes ... the frame limit and the 16-file cap bound it') but not the magnitude, and the 16-file cap does not bound a single decode. Adequate as a disclosure of kind, short of the brief's 'charge ... before the decode'.
findings_not_failures.repair_direction: give reel's whole-file decode a sample budget (decode_all already knows channels: check kept samples, not frames, per block) or a header probe for channels, and pass the remainder / 4 as samples; reel is outside this lane's owned paths
